title: Nuevo Laredo–Tampico flight launches November 14, linking border and Gulf coast
excerpt: Viva Aerobus will start a Nuevo Laredo–Tampico route on November 14, Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal said, giving border residents a direct air link to southern Tamaulipas.
content:
Nuevo Laredo is getting a new air link to the Gulf coast: a Viva Aerobus route between Nuevo Laredo and Tampico set to begin operations on November 14, Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal said during a visit to Tampico for the International Energy Congress.

The mayor said the route has drawn a favorable response and will give travelers an alternative between two of Tamaulipas' main economic regions — the border and the south — without a long overland trip. It also helps Veracruz natives living in Nuevo Laredo who travel toward southern Tamaulipas, she said.

For border families, the practical payoff is time: a flight replaces hours on the highway, and it arrives just as two seasonal movements pick up — November hunting season, which the mayor cited as an economic driver, and the return of paisanos for the holidays.

Canturosas Villarreal also used the Tampico visit to tout city projects, including paving, sanitary drainage and wastewater conveyance to treatment plants, and the recently inaugurated municipal planetarium, which the city wants to fold into its tourism offer beyond its traditional commercial and customs identity.

She also repeated the claim that Nuevo Laredo ranks among the five Mexican cities with the best security perception, attributing it to coordination among municipal, state and federal governments. That claim rests on the survey she cited during the interview; Webb Watch 956 notes it as the mayor's statement, not an independently verified ranking in this story.

What to watch: whether demand sustains the route past its launch. As the reporting itself notes, the flight's impact will depend on passenger demand and continuity of service — the same test every new regional route faces.

Sources:

  • Realidades, "Vuelo Tampico-Nuevo Laredo fortalecerá la conectividad y el turismo en Tamaulipas," October 30, 2026
